data.name: Slack: Create Channel
data.description: Create a new public or private Slack channel.
data.instructions:
Create a new Slack channel.

Create a public or private channel with the specified name.

**Inputs:**
- {name}: Channel name (lowercase, no spaces)
- {is_private}: Whether to create as a private channel (optional, defaults to false)

**Output:** {result} contains the created channel details including the channel ID.
